free_parameters.name: execution_threshold
free_parameters.why: repository default DeadlineSchedulerConfig.execution_threshold; the branch may replace it

free_parameters.name: execution_threshold_batched
free_parameters.why: repository default DeadlineSchedulerConfig.execution_threshold_batched; distinct from execution_threshold so the branch is observable

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: zero makes _schedule skip the decode/push loops after the sort, so no GPU block manager is needed after the target line

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: smallest realistic prompt length; the branch condition reads only self.tier, not the prompt

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: repository default CacheConfig.block_size; only used to build logical token blocks

free_parameters.name: arrival_time
free_parameters.why: fixed arrival time chosen for a deterministic ttft computation

free_parameters.name: ttft_deadline
free_parameters.why: TIER_DEADLINES[0] from sequence.py, used as the fixed ttft deadline; the branch does not read it

free_parameters.name: e2e_prefill_time
free_parameters.why: fixed nonzero prefill elapsed time so max(e2e_prefill_time, ttft_deadline) is well defined

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for the random tier drawn in Sequence.__init__; the tier is then set from the input
